body.name: \(h_{t,F}\)
body.construction: Run rational reduced-row-echelon elimination on the augmented row test \(A_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}\lambda=b_{\eta,t,F}\). If it is inconsistent, choose the lexicographically first free column in the reduced system for \(A_{\eta,t,F}u=0\), set that free coordinate to the least positive integer clearing all denominators, set later free coordinates to zero, solve the pivot coordinates, and change the sign if necessary so that \(b_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}u>0\); the resulting vector is \(h_{t,F}\). If the augmented system is consistent, return the symbol \(\mathsf{REJECT}\).
